scope: Independent soundscape/effects release verification only. Tracked source, documents, GitHub and GUI were not edited. Other agents may have unrelated working-tree changes.

unverified_checks.reason: Headless Dummy renderer returns identity for a deliberately zeroed MultiMesh transform; graphics readback is unsupported in this backend.

component_soak.memory_interpretation: Object, node and resource counts are flat after warmup. About 30 KiB static-memory drift is bounded over this short run and includes accumulating harness checks/snapshots. It is not proof of zero memory leakage over unlimited sessions.
component_soak.process_note: Accelerated 60 Hz component update calls with periodic real-time yields for the audio mixer; not 400 seconds of physical gameplay. All commands returned within the ten-minute task limit.

audio.capture: Actual Godot Master-bus float mixer under Dummy output; not offline addition of source files and not hardware loopback
audio.source_loop_boundary_steps: All loop seam sample steps were below the largest ordinary adjacent-sample step in their source. This does not establish inaudibility.
audio.sample_peak_bound_caveat: The loose triangle-inequality bound of all source peaks is 1.037 at unity Master, so arbitrary phase combinations are not mathematically proven clipping-free. Deliberately aligned four-voice clean/release stress over 32 cycles measured peak 0.898 with zero clipped/full-scale samples. Normal gameplay event combinations have fewer perfectly aligned same-cue voices.

harness_calibration: The first run assumed zero MultiMesh transform readback worked in the Dummy renderer. A deliberate zero-write returned identity (determinant 1); that graphical assertion is now explicitly unverified rather than a product defect. The initial diagnostic log is retained.
limitations: No subjective listening or musical/comfort judgment.
No Chrome or audio hardware/device-output validation.
No GPU cost, graphics readback or visible effect-quality validation in the headless Dummy renderer.
No full-course reachability or manual gameplay validation.
Short finite endurance run; not an unlimited-session leak proof.
